# environment at location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:environmentAtLocation`](gmeow-environmentAtLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/environmentAtLocation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The location whose ambient conditions this [`SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) describes. Functional: a [`SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) concerns exactly one location (constitutive of its identity).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) -> [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:environmentAtLocation`](gmeow-environmentAtLocation.md) from [`gmeow:SensoryEnvironment`](../classes/gmeow-SensoryEnvironment.md) to [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
